assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single transparent wall-window sprite for FLOPS, a simple children's handmade plasticine room game. A REAL hand-sculpted modelling-clay miniature with rounded shapes, slight fingerprints and soft warm studio lighting, not glossy plastic, not a flat illustration. Front-facing with very slight view of the deep window recess. SAME cream oatmeal chunky rounded rectangular window frame with a softly arched top, one generous uninterrupted pane, NO crossbars blocking the view; thick lower clay windowsill. Behind the pane is a miniature clay landscape; all scenery stays INSIDE the window opening. A small freestanding flag sits on the LOWER RIGHT windowsill. The whole frame and flag are clearly visible, centered square composition with 9% transparent margins. Genuine transparent background outside the entire window frame. No wall, room, characters, lettering, signs, watermark, ground shadow, or extra objects outside window. Recognizable landmark, simplified big readable forms for tiny shop thumbnails. Scene: Paris, France: the unmistakable Eiffel Tower rising over a green riverbank and the Seine, blue sky and two soft small clouds. Tiny French flag on sill: vertical blue, white, red.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: supplied single-paw clay wearable. This is NOT a shop thumbnail; it is a production front-layer dress-up sprite that must fit over a real pug paw. Keep the exact item's colors, sculpted clay material, overall outside silhouette, front decoration, laces, sole/knuckles, and camera. CHANGE ONLY its wrist/ankle opening: REMOVE the entire BACK HALF of the cuff/heel collar and the dark empty hole interior behind the invisible leg. The top opening must be a deep U-shaped TRANSPARENT cutout, OPEN at the upper edge, so the actual pug leg will show THROUGH it when composited. Leave only the curved front cuff rim across the lower front of the opening and the side edges; no oval closed ring, no back raised lip, no hollow dark empty shoe cup visible. The leg-facing empty region should be genuine transparent alpha, not black. The item should look like the FRONT HALF of clothing worn around an invisible paw, with no rear rim drawn in front of that paw. No pug, no leg, no body or other object. Preserve framing and scale exactly. Genuine transparent background everywhere outside remaining front garment. No shadow, floor, text or second item.
